facts.name: Morrow's Sedge
facts.light: Part shade to shade; average to moist soil
facts.notes: An evergreen sedge that makes a neat, dark-green fountain of blades all year. Clumping and low-maintenance.

sources.title: Ray Wiegand's Nursery: Ice Dance Sedge

companions.why: Walters Gardens (Zeeland, Michigan) lists varieties of these as companions: astilbe, lady fern 'Lady in Red', Brunnera 'Jack Frost' and Heuchera.
